component.name: eSemnBun
eSemnBun
component.summary: Sign and verify documents with the Moldovan eID card
Semnează și verifică documente cu buletinul de identitate

description.p: eSemnBun signs documents with the qualified certificate on the Moldovan electronic identity card (IDEMIA CosmoX ID-A) through a USB smart-card reader, and verifies signed documents offline.

ul.li: The card in the reader is shown as an identity card; with several cards, switch on the card itself
PDF documents are signed as PAdES-T, accepted by msign.gov.md
Other files are signed as detached XAdES (BES, T or C)
Verifies PAdES and XAdES signatures, timestamps and the certificate chain
Browser connection compatible with the MoldSign Desktop protocol, with consent before every signature
Optionally remembers the PIN in GNOME Keyring, per card; never retries a PIN automatically

description.p: eSemnBun semnează documente cu certificatul calificat de pe buletinul de identitate electronic al Republicii Moldova, printr-un cititor de carduri USB, și verifică documente semnate.
Encrypt and decrypt files with passwords or compatible encryption certificates and cards. Export public encryption certificates and remove supported local files with explicit confirmation.
Added terms, privacy policy and disclaimer information to About.
Local MCP automation, offline verification, and explicitly configured unattended signing.
Improved adaptive layouts, document details, and independent document history.
Optional visible PDF stamps, clearer batch options, and signed documents with direct verification.
First-run introduction and options for startup and card detection.
Certificate details, multiple document verification, improved batch signing and tablet file handling.
New name: eSemnBun. The card in the reader is drawn as an identity card, and with several cards you switch on the card itself. Packages for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora and Flatpak.
First GNOME build: signing, verification, activity, card details, browser connection, and a card wallet that shows every inserted card and selects the one used for signing.
